body: Found in the ledger/protocol review. `protocol.client_is_current` matches the header with `[0-9]+` and then calls `int()`; Python refuses to convert more than 4300 digits (ValueError), so an unauthenticated request with a 5000-digit `X-Client-Protocol` header is a 500 with a traceback instead of 426. The regex is bounded to at most nine digits (no protocol version will ever need more); anything longer is simply not a current client. Test with a 5000-digit header.
title: Protocol gate: a header of thousands of digits is a 500, not a 426
